text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a beautiful morning! The<n>temperature and
humidity are just<n>right!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Best of all, I woke up on my own ten<n>minutes
before the alarm!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Based on how fatigued I was, I didn't<n>think I would
be able to wake before<n>six o'clock... But somehow,
I got up<n>ten minutes early instead!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That must mean I'm becoming more<n>resilient than I
anticipated! What a<n>happy miscalculation!

Biwa Hayahide heads toward the<n>academy with a
bright smile on her<n>face.
